name: @cybermole/app-kit
description: The shared half of cybermole — what apps (and the console) are built on: the Result family + branded IDs, the node-free zod schema layer, the Result→HTTP mapping, the node:sqlite helper, the object-storage client, and the route-table binder. Ships SOURCE, no build step: astro/vite compiles it through the workspace symlink, the console's server tsc compiles it in place.
